description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the CandidateDao component in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM project. It contains various test methods verifying candidate and vacancy CRUD operations, filtering, and history recording functionality.

classes.name: CandidateDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests various functionalities of the CandidateDao, including saving, retrieving, filtering, and deleting candidates and related entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the CandidateDao instance and populates test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testSaveCandidate
methods.description: Tests saving a new candidate and verifies the returned object and fields.

methods.name: testSaveCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Tests saving a candidate vacancy record and verifies associations and fields.

methods.name: testGetCandidateById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of candidate details by ID, including null case.

methods.name: testGetCandidateVacancyByCandidateId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of candidate vacancy details by candidate ID.

methods.name: testDeleteCandidates
methods.description: Tests deleting candidates by IDs and ensures they are removed.

methods.name: testDeleteCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Tests deletion of a candidate vacancy record.

methods.name: testGetCandidateList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of candidate list with default filter.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByCandidateId
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates by candidate ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByVacancyId
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates by vacancy ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByJobTitleId
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates by job title ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByHiringMangerId
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates by hiring manager ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByStatus
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates by application status.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByMethodOfApplication
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates by method of application.

methods.name: testSaveCandidateHistory
methods.description: Tests saving candidate history record and verifies associated data.
